**Harbor 2.0.7** — the display name of a person.

- The field "Name" of the setup wizard, of a new user and of the profile is "Display name" now, with a hint: one line
  of free text (a first name, a full name), shown in the account menu and the list of users; people sign in with
  their user name. Russian: «Отображаемое имя» instead of «Название».
